text: うみで　ポケモン　つれば　もっと　あつまり　そうじゃ！

structure.jp: もっと　あつまり　そうじゃ！
structure.en: it looks like more will gather

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば after a verb means 'if'. つれば = 'if you fish'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ
patterns.span: あつまり　そうじゃ
patterns.explanation: Verb stem plus そう says it looks like it will happen. じゃ is the old-man form of だ. あつまりそうじゃ = 'it looks like they'll gather'.
